style: instrumental video game victory sting, 5 seconds. A milestone lands in a startup survival game — the product finally works, the first users arrive, the little team earned one good moment. A bright joyful trumpet and grand piano play a short rising fanfare fragment together, glockenspiel sparkles on top, one crisp snap ends it. Triumphant but charming and small — a garage band celebrating, never an orchestra, never epic. Modern punchy dry small-room production with a clean ending. 96 BPM feel, F major. No vocals, no choir, no cymbal wash, no fade-out.
